name: agent-comms
description: Real-time main/subagent communication for ZCode: bundled worker (full-tools executor) and scout (read-only recon) agent types with a three-boundary reporting protocol baked into their system prompts, plus open_channel/report/wait_worker_event/read_events MCP tools (collision-proof channels, wait-any-worker, server-side throttle, silence detection, auditable anchor artifacts).

description_i18n.en: Real-time main/subagent communication: bundled worker (full-tools executor) and scout (read-only recon) types with the reporting protocol baked in, plus open_channel/report/wait_worker_event/read_events MCP tools for wait-any-worker, silence detection and auditable anchor artifacts.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 主/子代理实时互通：自带 worker（全工具执行型）与 scout（只读核查型）两个 agent 类型，三层边界汇报协议随系统提示词注入；配套 open_channel/report/wait_worker_event/read_events 四个 MCP 工具，实现随机频道防串台、任意 worker 聚合等待、服务端节流、沉默检测与锚工件落盘审计。
